title: Wrap a mark
description: A cream geometric mark follows an unbranded cobalt canister as its surface placement changes and the vessel turns.
useCase: Explore one packaging mark's placement without opening a full branding editor.
interaction: Drag directly on the canister, use arrow keys to place the mark, and turn the vessel to inspect its side.
reducedMotion: Placement and inspection turn update directly, with no settling or automatic orbit.
limitations: One procedural cylinder and original geometric mark. Placement is cylindrical surface-coordinate mapping, not a general projected-decal engine. No source assets, fonts or textures. WebGL 1 with original SVG fallback and context restoration.
look: A matte cobalt canister with a quiet lid seam and cream geometric mark on warm stone; a red placement pin appears only during drag.
motion: Pointer rays intersect the cylinder to update surface angle and height. The mark remains attached to those coordinates as Turn changes the viewing angle; back surfaces stay occluded.
adapt: `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop expose mark scale, rotation and edge softness. `mark` defines the original graphic; `u_markAngle`/`u_markY` store surface placement, and `u_orbit` rotates the coordinate frame independently.
